title: HA Spatial Home Layout
description: Canonical persisted/wire contract for a spatial home layout. Frozen at v1 by the 2026-06 eng review. Validated by BOTH the Python integration and the TypeScript panel (decision 4A). Conventions: snake_case keys (HA-native, matches area_id/floor_id/entity_id); all coordinates in real-world METERS; entity placements are a GLOBAL array each optionally linked to a room via room_id (decision T2, no mapping table); calibration is a distance-pair, never pixel-based.

version.description: Schema version. Bumped only with a matching Store async_migrate_func (decision 4A).

calibration.description: Provenance of how real-world scale was established. Geometry is already stored in meters; this records the reference used so the model can be re-calibrated. Distance-pair (real vs measured), never pixel_scale.

area_id.description: HA area registry link (decision 2A/T2). null = not yet linked. This IS the room↔area mapping; there is no separate mapping table.

floor_id.description: HA floor registry link (decision 3A). null = unassigned.

floor_level.description: Geometric storey index / render height-offset (decision 3A). Distinct from floor_id.

polygon.description: Wall polygon, top-down, in meters. Structural minimum is 3 points; semantic checks (no self-intersection, closed-ring normalization) are enforced by the WS boundary validator, decision 8A.

origin.description: Room's local (0,0) position in the shared home frame, in meters. Absent = identity (room renders at origin).

rotation.description: Rotation of the room's local frame about its local origin, in degrees. Absent = identity.

orphaned.description: Tombstone flag (decision 2A). true when the linked HA area was deleted; geometry is retained and the room is restorable.

room_id.description: Optional direct link to a room (decision T2). null = placed but unassigned to a room.

position.description: Room-local position in meters. Resolved to world coordinates via the linked room's origin/rotation transform.
